headword: {動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか}

definitions.explanation: A medical condition in which the walls of the arteries thicken and lose elasticity, restricting blood flow.

examples.japanese: {動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか}は{生活|せいかつ}{習慣|しゅうかん}{病|びょう}の{一|ひと}つだ。
examples.english: Arteriosclerosis is one of the lifestyle-related diseases.

examples.japanese: {喫煙|きつえん}や{高脂肪|こうしぼう}の{食事|しょくじ}は{動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか}のリスクを{高|たか}める。
examples.english: Smoking and a high-fat diet increase the risk of arteriosclerosis.

examples.japanese: {定期的|ていきてき}な{運動|うんどう}と{食事|しょくじ}の{改善|かいぜん}は{動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか}の{予防|よぼう}に{効果的|こうかてき}だと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Regular exercise and dietary improvements are said to be effective in preventing arteriosclerosis.

notes:
A compound of {動脈|どうみゃく} (artery) and {硬化|こうか} (hardening). This is one of the most commonly discussed health conditions in Japanese media, particularly in the context of {生活習慣病|せいかつしゅうかんびょう} (lifestyle diseases) and aging.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか}を{防|ふせ}ぐ: to prevent arteriosclerosis
- {動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか}が{進|すす}む: arteriosclerosis progresses
- {動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか}の{検査|けんさ}: test for arteriosclerosis
- {動脈硬化|どうみゃくこうか}{症|しょう}: arteriosclerotic disease

RELATED TERMS:
- {動脈|どうみゃく}: artery
- {静脈|じょうみゃく}: vein
- {心筋梗塞|しんきんこうそく}: heart attack (myocardial infarction)
- {脳卒中|のうそっちゅう}: stroke
